name: BioRegenx, Inc.
summary: BioRegenx, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells medical test equipment, science-based nutritional products, and AI-driven health monitoring technologies. Its products include the GlycoCheck system for microvascular health assessment, the Endocalyx Pro dietary supplement, and the DocSun AI engine for contactless vital sign monitoring. The company focuses on regenerative biotherapeutics, anti-aging, and non-invasive medical and wellness devices.
